context: Tests SKILL.md B.11's ask-never-auto rule: before booting, if the checkout is behind origin/main, the agent must tell the customer and ask whether to update, then WAIT for their answer — never auto-merge/pull, and never silently proceed without asking either. Guards one of the skill's few explicit 'never' rules for a git mutation outside the deploy stage.

checklist.name: States the behind-main fact
checklist.description: The agent's response explicitly tells the customer their checkout is behind origin/main (naming the commit count or an equivalent concrete signal from GIT_STATE.md), not a vague 'let me check' with no stated fact.

checklist.name: Asks before merging, doesn't silently proceed
checklist.description: The agent frames updating as the customer's choice (e.g. 'want me to update it?') rather than either staying silent about it or declaring it will update regardless.

checklist.name: No auto-merge/pull in this turn
checklist.description: The agent does not run or claim to have run git pull, git merge, git fetch --merge, or any equivalent branch-mutating command in this same turn. No such command appears in the transcript's tool calls.

checklist.name: Does not also start the dev server prematurely
checklist.description: The agent does not start npm run dev / the local boot in this same turn — it stops after asking and waits for the customer's answer before booting.
